prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1008; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed claim materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Our client has retained us to protect their interests while medical treatment and the evaluation of damages are ongoing.

We request that you provide, within thirty days, a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with the full policy limits for bodily injury and property damage coverage, and disclose any additional coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
